task_summary: Resolved self-similarity false positives, added canonical similarity thresholds, enforced accessible proposal submission gating (disabled button with aria-describedby, alert banner, and server 409 conflict gate), implemented stable proposal ID keying, strict stage/modal precedence, and comprehensive test battery.

hypothesis_proof.self_similarity_backfire: When proponents edited existing proposals, checkProposalSimilarity and checkTitleSimilarity omitted excludeProjectId or matched against the user's active team project, producing 100% false-positive match against their own project. Fixed in server controller, service, and client TitleSimilarityChecker by passing, validating via mongoose.Types.ObjectId.isValid, and auto-resolving excludeProjectId to team project with safe unassigned student fallback.
hypothesis_proof.stage_indicator_and_pitch_deck_modal: Matched records in proposal stage lack abstracts and tech stacks. Updated TitleSimilarityChecker and SimilarProjectModal to compute stageInfo with strict precedence (Archived Manuscript > Capstone 4 > Capstone 3 > Capstone 2 > Capstone 1 > safe defaults), render the 6 BukSU pitch deck sections (Problem Statement, Solution, Innovation, Beneficiaries, Expected Value/Impact, Disciplines & SDGs) when in proposal mode, and provide institutional navigation buttons (View in Archive / View Project).
hypothesis_proof.proposal_update_gating_and_accessibility: Proponents were previously able to submit or update proposals during pending scans or when high similarity conflicts (>= 65%) were present. Standardized on accessible disabled button with aria-describedby='similarity-conflict-banner', tooltip title, and role='alert' warning banner. Eliminated contradictory toast nagging and added server-side 409 TITLE_SIMILARITY_CONFLICT clearance gate in submitTitle.
hypothesis_proof.stable_proposal_ids: Keyed proposal similarity results, live scan, and plagiarism results by stable proposal.id (generateProposalId()) rather than array index, ensuring state persistence across proposal switching, reordering, and deletion.

verification_evidence.playwright_visual_audit: 8 visual audit screenshots captured across desktop (1440x900) & mobile (390x844) in light & dark modes verifying conflict warning banner, locked submit button, and SimilarProjectModal pitch deck presentation
